title: joserfc: Compact JWS size guard allocates attacker-controlled segments before rejection (CVE-2026-119284)
description: joserfc 1.7.4 has a vulnerability in its compact JWS size guard where it allocates attacker-controlled segments before rejecting oversized inputs. This occurs because the library calls bytes.split() on the input before validating its length, causing an additional payload-sized memory allocation. The flaw allows an attacker to cause excessive memory usage before the size limit triggers rejection. A fix is available in version 3.4.2_1.
